summary: One-frame request to play a character's death 'explode' effect, created by the client death system (bg3.exe+0x1959370, macOS ecl::death::CharacterSystem::Update) from the character template's death-effect entry of type 5; consumed by ecl::EffectManagerProxySystem.

fields.name: Effect
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x195D130 writes 0xFFFFFFFF (with +4, one 8-byte -1 store); destructor bg3.exe+0x67FC50 releases FixedStrings at +0 and +4. bg3.exe+0x1959370 sets it from +0x34 of the template's death-effect entry whose type byte (+0x28) is 5.

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: Released by the destructor; bg3.exe+0x1959370 sets it from a FixedString held by the system object (this+0x20) - probably a bone or attachment name.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes; bg3.exe+0x1959370 copies 8 + 4 bytes from +0x10 of the character's transform (translation).

fields.name: Rotation
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +0x14..+0x20 and writes 1.0 at +0x20 (identity w); bg3.exe+0x1959370 copies four floats from +0 of the transform (rotation).

fields.name: Scale
fields.evidence: Creator writes 1.0; bg3.exe+0x1959370 writes the largest of the three scale components of the transform (+0x1C..+0x28).

open_questions: Meaning of field_4 (a FixedString owned by the system).
Quaternion component order follows the transform copy (x, y, z, w with w at +0x20).
